name: belt_band
where: Full waist band wrapping the whole body, approx y 0.635 to 0.66, about 0.02 tall, sitting just below the coat's chest placket and above the hip flaps.
shape: A wide flat strap band with squared edges and a slightly raised rim.
notes: Band is built as two wrap segments at the back, meeting at a seam near the rear-left. Hip flaps and coat skirt hang below it. Belt sits over the coat body.

name: belt_front_centre_tab
where: Front centre, x about 0.48 to 0.52, y about 0.625 to 0.645, on the belt directly under the top placket buttons.
shape: A short rectangular keeper tab lying flat on the belt with a small rounded cap at each end.
notes: Two gold coat buttons on the placket sit either side of the tab at roughly the same height. Tab could be part of the belt or a separate clasp.

name: belt_buckle_left_rear
where: Character's left rear flank, approx x 0.56 to 0.62 at the back, y 0.63 to 0.655, at the belt's wrap seam.
shape: A rectangular buckle frame with a pin bar and a short keeper strap wrapping the belt end.
in_reference: differs: the character-sheet detail shows a buckle with a hanging diamond-shaped pendant; the sculpt has no pendant
notes: Buckle sits over the belt end and is partly covered by the rear wrap. Pendant is missing from the sculpt.

name: belt_rivet_studs
where: Front: about 2 per flank, near x 0.41 and x 0.58 at y about 0.645. Back: 2 studs near x 0.45 and x 0.55 plus 1 to 2 on the buckle keeper and 1 near the left side seam.
shape: Small domed round rivets with gold rims set flush into the belt.
notes: Exact per-side counts are uncertain because the belt wraps around the body. Left and right are roughly symmetric at the front, with more studs on the character's left rear.

name: hip_flap_upper
where: One on each hip, x about 0.30 to 0.38 (character's right) and x about 0.62 to 0.70 (character's left), y about 0.58 to 0.61, extending from the side seam toward the front.
shape: A short, wide, flat tab with an angled lower edge and a gold stitched or piped border.
notes: Sits over the hip apron plate below it. The front tex shows one stud per flap, while the side views show two, so stud count per flap is uncertain.

name: hip_flap_upper_stud
where: Two per hip flap, one near the outer corner and one near the centre, at about y 0.59 to 0.60.
shape: Small domed round studs with gold rims.
notes: Count is per flap as seen in the side clay views. Front view shows only one stud per flap.

name: hip_apron_plate
where: One on each hip, x about 0.30 to 0.40 and x about 0.60 to 0.70, y about 0.50 to 0.56, under the upper flap and running down the side of the skirt.
shape: A shield-shaped apron plate with a rounded top corner and a pointed lower edge, with a gold edge.
notes: Upper flap lies over the apron plate. The apron edge runs into the side skirt panel below. Material could be leather or hard armour; the sculpt does not settle it.

name: hip_apron_stud
where: Three per apron plate, scattered near the top and centre at about y 0.52 to 0.56.
shape: Small domed round studs with gold rims.
notes: Stud positions are irregular in the sculpt. Counts are approximate.

name: hip_hanging_loop_cord
where: Character's right hip (image left in front view), x about 0.36 to 0.42, y about 0.55 to 0.60, hanging below the upper flap.
shape: A dark curved cord or strap loop that drops from the flap and curls back toward the body.
notes: Hangs over the right front skirt panel edge. Reads as a hook or key loop.

name: side_hanging_strap
where: One along each side seam, running from about y 0.70 at the shoulder down to about y 0.52 over the side skirt panels.
shape: A long narrow dark strap or cord hanging down the side with a slight wave.
notes: The side views show a strap running down near the side seam. The design side view does not show it at this height. It may be a sling or a hanging cord, so the role is unresolved.

name: front_skirt_panel
where: Character's right panel x about 0.40 to 0.48, character's left panel x about 0.52 to 0.60. Both run from belt y about 0.62 down to hem y about 0.20.
shape: Two long tapered coat-front skirt leaves that meet at a centre split and end in pointed hem tails.
notes: Each panel is edged with gold piping (see front_placket_trim_strip). Panels overlap the side skirt panels at the hip.

name: front_skirt_split_liner
where: Centre front, x about 0.47 to 0.53, from y about 0.45 down to hem y about 0.20.
shape: A dark, near-black inner liner visible through a narrow recessed V-gap between the two front panels.
notes: Gap widens toward the hem. Liner sits under the front panels and over the tattered underskirt.

name: side_skirt_panel
where: Character's left panel x about 0.62 to 0.70 and character's right panel x about 0.30 to 0.38, from y about 0.60 to hem y about 0.20.
shape: Long side tails tapering to a pointed hem, lying behind the front panels and in front of the back panel.
notes: Edged with a gold strip on the outer edge. Layering: under the front skirt panels, over the back skirt panel.

name: back_centre_skirt_panel
where: Back centre, x about 0.40 to 0.60, from belt y about 0.62 down to hem y about 0.20.
shape: A broad full-length back panel that flares toward the hem.
notes: Carries the back trim and pleats. Hem edge is a soft curve with small tatters.

name: back_skirt_pleats
where: Vertical folds across the back panel, x about 0.40 to 0.60, running from belt y about 0.62 to hem y about 0.20.
shape: Soft sculpted fold ridges that open out toward the hem.
notes: Folds are sculpted geometry rather than separate panels. Count of five is approximate.

name: front_placket_trim_strip
where: One along each edge of the front split, at x about 0.46 and x about 0.54, from y about 0.62 down to hem y about 0.20.
shape: A thin raised gold piping strip that follows the panel edge.
notes: Continuous with the upper placket trim above the belt. Gold colour in the tex view confirms metal.

name: skirt_hem_trim_strip
where: Along the pointed hem edges of the front, side and back skirt panels, at about y 0.20 to 0.25.
shape: Thin gold piping that follows each pointed hem tail.
notes: Count is one per visible tail edge, approximate. Some hem tails are short and may be merged by the modeller.

name: back_centre_seam_trim
where: Back centre seam, x about 0.50, from belt y about 0.62 down to hem y about 0.20.
shape: A raised gold strip running straight down the back centre seam.
notes: Clay shows only a faint seam groove, so this is a painted trim that should be geometry.

name: back_gold_cross_ornament
where: Back centre at belt level, x about 0.48 to 0.52, y about 0.60 to 0.70, crossing the belt.
shape: A gilt cross with flared arms, set in relief on the back.
in_reference: differs: the back reference shows a raised cross ornament at belt level; the clay has no relief there
notes: Missing from the sculpt as geometry. Gold paint only.

name: back_tail_cross_motifs
where: Two motifs on the back tail, x about 0.45 and x about 0.55, y about 0.25 to 0.32, flanking the centre seam.
shape: Gothic gilt sub-cross motifs in relief on the back skirt tails.
in_reference: differs: the back reference shows raised gold motifs; the clay has none
notes: Shown as gold paint in the tex view only. Probably a missing raised detail.

name: front_panel_gold_sigils
where: Scattered on the front skirt panels, roughly y 0.25 to 0.45, two per panel.
shape: Small gold star and line-art sigil motifs.
in_reference: differs: the reference shows raised gold sigil line-art on the front panels; the clay has none
notes: Mostly painted in the tex view. Clay shows no relief, so these read as paint-only.

name: tattered_underskirt_layer
where: Under the coat skirt, hem region y about 0.15 to 0.25, around the full circumference.
shape: Dark torn, spiky under-layer with ragged hem points.
notes: Sits under the coat skirt panels. Possibly owned by the lower-leg or hem region; listed here because it is liner.
